newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE says Canadian hog futures contract "feasible".
newsitem.headline: WCE says Canadian hog futures contract "feasible".

text.p: A study conducted by U.S. analytical firm Sparks Companies has shown that a Canadian hog futures contract is feasible, a statement issued by the Winnipeg Commodity Exchange said.

The statement said the WCE Board of Governors had met on Wednesday and approved the creation of an industry committee composed of WCE members and hog industry participants. It will present a business plan to the Board by early April.
"The feasibility study noted the timing for a Canadian hog contract is excellent, as provinces switch to a flexible marketing system," the statement said.
Grains, oilseeds and feed peas are currently traded on the WCE but not livestock futures. A U.S.-based hog futures contract is traded on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
